children: A Kazakhstan auction of TethysAralGas's pledged pipelines and related infrastructure is scheduled for Nov. 26, 2026, at a starting price of KZT 1.435B. Production reached 550 tons per day during compressor testing, versus 455 tons per day before installation.
Auction set Nov. 26; starting price KZT 1.435B
The pledged pipelines and facilities support TAG operations; a sale or transfer could affect access and operational continuity.
Cassation ruling left forced sale order in effect
The ruling reversed prior decisions favoring TAG, increasing near-term risk that the auction proceeds.
This exceeds the 455 tons/day pre-installation rate; the expected increase to about 575 tons/day remains forward-looking.
Tethys seeks suspension; outcome is uncertain
The company is challenging the auction, but says there is no assurance it will be suspended or postponed.
DSFK ordered to repay about KZT 1.435B
Recovery efforts continue, but recoveries to date have been limited and the amount still payable has not been verified.

This is a continuation of a long-running dispute over pledged operating assets, now approaching a scheduled auction, alongside a near-term production update. The next catalyst is whether Tethys obtains a suspension or the Nov. 26 auction proceeds and affects TAG's access to the infrastructure.
